The '''Electrorod''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that used electricity over blunt edges.
The tip of an electrorod packed enough charge that it could knock an opponent unconscious with just a grazing blow.

==History==
In [[3954 BBY]] a [[Unidentified female mercenary (Dromund Kaas)|female]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] owned a short Electrorod and used it in [[Skirmish outside of Darth Nyriss's stronghold|combat]] against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] shortly before her [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The electrorod first appeared within [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', which was published on [[November 15]], [[2011]].
